mechanism_narrative: A high federal funds rate indicates tight monetary conditions, which increases borrowing costs and reduces consumer and business spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of periods when FEDFUNDS is above 4%, this hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4% signals a strong labor market, which may lead to wage inflation and higher corporate costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE is below 4%, this hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A slowdown in GDP growth, indicated by a decline in GDPC1, suggests weakening aggregate demand, which may lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive 60-day returns in more than 40% of periods when GDPC1 growth is negative, this hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production, indicated by a rise in INDPRO, suggests strong supply conditions, which may lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative 20-day returns in more than 30% of periods when INDPRO is rising, this hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low unemployment (UNRATE) and high payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strong labor market, which may lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of periods when both UNRATE is low and PAYEMS is high, this hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: High real sales (RSAFS) indicate strong consumer demand, which may lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative 5-day returns in more than 30% of periods when RSAFS is high, this hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL) indicates tight monetary conditions, which may lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive 60-day returns in more than 40% of periods when both FEDFUNDS is rising and CPIAUCSL is high, this hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong demand in the housing market, which may lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative 60-day returns in more than 30% of periods when HOUST is rising, this hypothesis is rejected.
